answer.rationale: With the incumbent refusing to reopen price and the contract expiring in 14 days, renewal or negotiation cannot meet the mandated 18% component-spend reduction. memory_c2 is the only inherited evidence supporting a sharp unit-cost reduction with fast onboarding, so it should be verified before relying on it. memory_c3 indicates second sourcing would reduce delivery risk, but it does not achieve the required cost cut and would consume the single decision slot. Given the line is at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, the switch should be executed as a guarded transition rather than an abrupt full migration.
